en: Sepia-toned interior view of a grand hunting lodge hall. The room has two ornate fireplaces on either side, a central double door with elaborate stucco decoration and mounted antlers and a stag skull above it. Numerous deer antlers and hunting trophies are mounted high on the walls. Portrait paintings of royals or nobility hang between the fireplaces and doorway. Simple wooden chairs with heart-shaped backs line the walls, and a carved wooden table stands in the center. Printed German captions identify the place as the royal hunting lodge Moritzburg and the specific room as the stone hall, with a publisher credit along the bottom.
